title: Walking down to a school, a class or a person

steps.say: **Below this** draws everything hanging beneath the level you are on — groups inside groups, the classes in each, the teachers who take them and the staff who teach nothing yet. It is a picture of the shape, not a list to filter.

The caret to the left of a name opens and closes what sits under it. The top two levels open themselves and deeper ones wait to be tapped, so a large organisation shows you its shape rather than eighty-five rows.

Tapping a name walks you down to it, and the numbers above redraw for that level. A class row already names its teachers and its student count without you opening it; where there are more than eight, a **more** button reveals the rest.
steps.terminal: That's the whole tree, one tap per level down. This tour changed nothing; only your own taps do.
